exposure: full thickness suturing of the uterine incision
Type of uterine incision closure (extramucosal suturing vs. full-thickness suturing)
outcome: Surface area of uterine scar defect (niche)
cohort: 241 women who underwent primary cesarean section, with 115 having their uterine incisions closed using a running full-thickness technique and 126 having extramucosal suturing.
finding: Extramucosal suturing of the uterine incision was associated with a thicker uterine scar and a smaller niche on ultrasound examination at 6 weeks postpartum.
mod_finding: Extramucosal suturing resulted in a thicker uterine scar and smaller niche compared to full-thickness suturing.
